
# Contributing to UI Library

Thank you for considering contributing to this project!

## How to Contribute

- Fork the repository
- Create a feature branch
- Write tests for your changes
- Follow coding standards
- Open a pull request

## Code Style

We use ESLint and Prettier for coding standards. Please ensure your code passes linting and formatting before committing.

## Reporting Issues

Use the issue templates provided in `.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE`.

## Communication

Please be respectful and professional in all interactions.
